subject.title: [Feature]: CLI command to list pending exec approval requests

question: Should the first CLI surface for pending exec approvals be read-only list/json only, or should it include resolve/respond and watch behavior now?
rationale: Listing pending command text and especially resolving approvals from CLI touches an operator security boundary, so the durable CLI contract needs maintainer intent before automation should implement or adopt a broader PR.

options.title: Ship List/JSON First
options.body: Expose `pending`/`list` through the existing `exec.approval.list` RPC and leave resolve/respond/watch for separately reviewed follow-ups.

options.title: Adopt Broader CLI Control
options.body: Use the active broader PR direction and require live proof plus security review for both listing and resolving approvals.

options.title: Defer CLI Exposure
options.body: Keep pending approval inspection in existing UI/backend paths until maintainers decide the CLI operator contract is worth the added surface.

recommendation.title: Ship List/JSON First
recommendation.body: Expose `pending`/`list` through the existing `exec.approval.list` RPC and leave resolve/respond/watch for separately reviewed follow-ups.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced and repeatedly maintained the approvals CLI/docs surface and previously scoped the narrow list/json path on this issue.
